summary.text: Jason Litalien is an independent candidate for the Maine State Senate, District 32, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
His Ballotpedia survey response describes him as an attorney, U.S. Air Force veteran and small business owner from Biddeford.

paragraphs.text: Jason Litalien graduated from Biddeford High School, served in the U.S. Air Force from 1996 to 2008, and earned a law degree from the University of Maine School of Law.

His survey response says he was born and raised in Biddeford, where he lives and works, and that he founded Litalien Law, a practice focused on real estate, probate, estate planning and business matters.
The response lists affordability and housing, fiscal responsibility and tax reform, and service, accountability and local representation as his key messages.
